market_outlook.short_term: Markets volatile and risk-off near-term. Iran conflict keeps oil elevated and inflation fears alive. August jobs data likely weak, supporting rate-cut expectations but raising recession concerns. Dollar weakness continues; EM outperformance persists. European cyclicals showing early recovery signals. Expect 2-3% volatility in equities over next 2-3 weeks.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex cycle remains intact with selective winners. EM and Asia rotation is structural, not cyclical. Defense spending elevated for 3-5 years. Energy transition (geothermal, storage) gaining institutional backing. Consumer bifurcation persists. Pharma pricing reform creates winners/losers. Robotaxi commercialization accelerates 2026-2027.
